evidence.source: Owner-authorised Production promotion 185 to 188 on 13 August 2026, executed through the checked-in guarded pair from exact main 1510a6e3f0ed77c2e83983507edbcc42e4b02dd8: rollout run 31739706612, gated on fresh backup run 31730225719 and rehearsal run 31739287772. The rollout independently verified both gating runs against the Actions API rather than trusting the dispatcher, required the rehearsal's head to equal the head being promoted, and required the backup to PRECEDE the rehearsal. All three migrations are additive, so check-migration-additive.mjs ran as a GATE rather than as the report the destructive 157-to-158 promotion needed, and the dry run was required to be exactly 20260812080000_cup_group_stage_span, 20260812090000_season_cup_qualification_driver and 20260813100000_ai_lab_multi_model_evidence by name, refusing a fourth. Independent postflight at 20:14:11Z NAMES all three ledger rows rather than counting them, beside a total of 188 and the named latest row. Protected application counts are unchanged across the apply: 1 auth user, 1 profile, 3 tournaments, 56 teams, 51 matches, 3 entries, 36 match predictions, 1 league, 1 league membership, 0 score events, 3 entry totals, 7 game memberships, 10 bonus competitions, 578 season fixtures, 16 season predictions, 2 player action items and 0 reminder deliveries. cron.job holds 14 jobs before and after, of which the four ai-odds schedules are unchanged, and Euro publication remains hidden. ZERO PROVIDER CALLS were made during backup, rehearsal or rollout: ai.api_usage holds 10 rows before and after, and ai.api_budget.collection_enabled was false before the rollout, is asserted false after, and the rollout refuses to run against a Production whose collection has been re-enabled. Paid collection remains deliberately disabled under the reason KNOWN_IDENTITY_PIPELINE_CORRUPTION recorded at 2026-08-13T15:09Z. The retained AI evidence is untouched by the promotion: 52 odds events, 51 predictions, 1137 market prices, 425 fixture odds, 49 bets and 46215 raw matches, each unchanged. Contract 188's identity repair, quarantine and budget reconciliation authorities are INSTALLED AND UNCALLED — ai.provider_identity_repairs, ai.prediction_invalidations and ai.recommendations all hold 0 rows — because a migration that repaired on arrival would make the repair unauditable; calling them is a separate operator action. Installed definitions were verified from the Production catalogue rather than from migration text: public.record_ai_odds_snapshot creates no temporary table and re-derives identity through ai.canonical_from_odds_api, and no function in public or predictor_internal retains a temporary-table dependency. public.admin_ai_bet_builder_candidates carries the identity argument types text, text[], timestamp with time zone, timestamp with time zone, integer. Contract 186 installed public.bonus_cup_launches with row-level security, its immutability trigger and no browser grant, holding 0 launch rows on this project. Contract 187 generalises the Championship qualification gate in place, and the tournament is measured as unchanged rather than assumed: all 4 tournament Championships resolve a group-stage span of exactly 3, and contract 169's cup_final_group_tables still carries its between 1 and 3 bound. Contract 188 seeded 223 alias rows; ai.canonical_from_odds_api, ai.repair_provider_identity, ai.reconcile_api_budget, ai.quarantine_identity_defective_predictions and the ai.valid_predictions view all exist, the three new ai tables all carry row-level security, no browser role reaches the repair, reconciliation or quarantine authorities, and no browser role holds direct DML on any ai relation. The four bounded admin RPCs are executable by authenticated and by no anonymous role. This is database promotion only: it publishes no Euro 2028, launches no competition, draws no Championship, imports no football and claims no Netlify application publication.
